memory.body: Every API route must call authMiddleware before reading req.accountId; the middleware is not global, so a new route added without it sees an undefined account.

distractors.body: Routes are registered in routes.ts; keep them alphabetical.
The logger redacts tokens; never log raw headers.

directEvidence.src/auth/middleware.ts: export const authMiddleware = (req: any) => { req.accountId = req.header ?? 'acc'; };
